summary: Backend regression suite (27 tests) covers auth, chat, stories, communities, broadcast, media. 26 passed, 1 skipped. All auth flows (register/login/me/logout/lockout/two-step), chat (idempotent send, edit/delete/react/forward/pin/typing/search), stories (feed, text story CRUD, close_friends audience), communities (public/private join flows, canRead=false), broadcast (contacts CRUD, 409 dup, CSV preview, templates/segments, campaign create+submit+delivery, non-VYBE => external_provider_not_configured, analytics, recipient unsubscribe), and media access control work as specified. Frontend: language selection with 8 Indic languages renders correctly; Kannada selected -> auth screen -> login as demo -> Chats tab renders in Kannada with no raw translation keys. All 4 tabs (Chats/Stories/Communities/Broadcast) navigate and render. CRITICAL: opening any chat row triggers ErrorBoundary ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading type)') at Bubble component — chat screen fully unusable in web preview. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Note: the frontend uses expo-audio (not expo-av), which is correct.

minor.issue: audience enum is 'everyone' (not 'all' as mentioned in request). React Native app passes 'everyone' so OK, but doc inconsistency.
Return 204 (not 200) on success; harmless but not documented.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening any chat row crashes via ErrorBoundary: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading type)' at Bubble. Likely cause: `conv={c!}` is passed non-null while conv query is still loading, so `conv.type === 'group'` on line 55 throws. FlatList renders when `initial` (messages) is false, but conv query (line 30) can still be undefined. Guard with `if (!c) return null;` at top of Bubble OR gate the FlatList on `!initial && c`.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console logs a 500 error during the auth transition. Login then succeeds; appears to be a protected endpoint hit before the token is attached. Low impact but noisy.

issues: Orphan test story 'hi' from TestStories.test_text_story_crud_and_viewers appears briefly in the Priya Sharma story group when run too close in sequence; stories expire in 24h so it will auto-clean. No action required.

Investigate stray 500 console error on login transition (likely an auth-less fetch firing early).

rca_of_issue: Chat open crash RCA: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx line 222 renders FlatList once `initial` (messages fetched) is false. However the conversation detail query (line 30) is independent, and on first paint `c = conv.data` can still be undefined when messages have already arrived (particularly on web where fetches race). Line 233 passes `conv={c!}`. Inside Bubble (/app/frontend/src/components/chat.tsx:55) the very first field access is `conv.type === 'group'` — on undefined this throws `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'type')`, caught by ErrorBoundary, producing the 'Something went wrong' screen. Reproduction: Playwright run included — login as demo, tap any chat-row-*, screen immediately shows the error boundary. Mitigation: either (a) gate FlatList on `!initial && c` to delay rendering until both resources are present, (b) guard inside Bubble (`if (!conv) return null;`), or (c) remove the non-null assertion and use `conv={c}` after making Conversation optional in Bubble props. (a) is cheapest and most correct.
